units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:12:1">Cant. R. to VI, 12</cite> <he>אין הוא מסתכל לההיא מ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>לההוא</he>) if he looks up to that stall where he used to sit tailoring &c.—Pl. <cite ref="M01896"><he>מִסְטוֹבְיָיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:7:2">Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>לא … על מ׳ ברייתא וכ׳</he> sit not on the outer benches of the hall of Bar Ula, for they are cold.
